page.layout: One page of running text in a single column, with no marginal notes. Running head at top centre, page number at top right. At the foot: a gathering signature at left, a catchword at right.

main_text.p: Quod à Deo, per occup. Est à vobis offensus de-molitione altarium, statuarum, &c.
Ratio II. ex ver.8.9. à necessario: Estis pau-ci & virib. impares potentiae tot principum, magnatum, &c.
Ratio III. ex ver.25. ab honesto seu Dei jus-su, ut delcant nostras Ecclesias.
Prob. I à genere doctrinae nostrae & fu[?] quia nos negemus omnipotentiam Dei, evertamus Testamentum Christi, &c. Ipsi defendant majestatem Christi, &c.
2. à successibus doctrinae ipsorum, quae magnas Vbique faciat accessiones.
Ratio IV. ex versic.13. ab utili seu commodis subscriptionis 1. Comedetis unusquisque de vite vestra. 2. Inibitis gratiam totius imperii Romani.
Ratio V. ex v.33. 34. 35. est farcastica expro-bratio mortis piorum principum passim audita? Vbi nunc Calvinistarum Deus CASIMIRUS? Vbi CHRISTIANUS Saxo? &c.?
Claudatur epiphonemate pathetico: Talibus proh dolor jam summi & infimi nobis insultant.
Per adversativum subjiciatur quarta pars pre-cationis, brevis confutatio ex ver.18. constans.

1. Concessione primae, secundae, quartae & quin-tae rationis, h.e, confessione defectionis, atq; im-becillitatis, quam exprobrant, & commodorum, quae promittunt, & peccatorum, quibus offen-sus Deus, Ecclesiam tantis heroibus & patronis privet.

page.notes: Doubtful readings: "fu[?]" in the Prob. paragraph, a stray mark between "fu" and "quia" that may be a printing flaw; "2." before "à successibus" may be "1." in the scan; "delcant" appears as printed (probably for "deleant"); the "Ratio" numerals and "ex v.33. 34. 35." spacing are uncertain at the scan's resolution. Show-through text from the reverse side, a faint text fragment in the middle of the page, and the page edges were left out.
